title: Just Optimisations and QoL
description: Adds a bunch of client-side mods to optimise and improve your game experience
body:
This modpack features multiple mods to optimise and improve your Minecraft experience!
All the mods are client-side, meaning you can use it on any server!

Some of the mods featured include:
- Sodium (for many optimisations)
- Iris (for shaders)
- Essential Mod (chat with friends, easy multiplayer)
- And 32 more!

Using all of the mods in this mod pack, your game should run better, and your experience could be better!

Enjoy the experience!

made by mautip for [Creamers Inc.](https://modrinth.com/organization/creamers-inc) <3
